clusters.headline: Officials Demand Justice After Student Silva Nur Intania Putri Dies
aiSummaryBullets: Government officials and the KPAI have called for a thorough and transparent police investigation into the death of 17-year-old student SN.
Tensions escalated in Malang as crowds gathered at the home of a juvenile suspect, resulting in property damage and injuries to local police.

clusters.headline: Basarnas Ends Search At Pongkor Mine With 14 Miners Still Missing
aiSummaryBullets: Search and rescue teams have officially ended operations at the illegal gold mine site in Pongkor, Bogor.
A total of 13 miners were recovered deceased from the site, while 14 individuals remain missing.

clusters.headline: Marc Marquez To Retire From MotoGP Following 2026 Racing Season
aiSummaryBullets: Eight-time world champion Marc Marquez officially announced his retirement from professional MotoGP racing effective after the 2026 season.
The rider cited the cumulative impact of physical injuries sustained during past career accidents, including incidents at Mandalika and Le Mans, as primary factors.

clusters.headline: Budi Arie Answers 42 Questions In Bareskrim Treason Investigation
aiSummaryBullets: Budi Arie Setiadi underwent nine hours of questioning by Bareskrim Polri investigators.
The inquiry included 42 questions regarding a treason case involving Listyo Sigit Prabowo.

clusters.headline: Shin Tae-yong Prepares Persija Jakarta For Garudayaksa FC Match
aiSummaryBullets: Persija Jakarta head coach Shin Tae-yong is preparing his squad to face Garudayaksa FC during the club's 98th-anniversary celebrations.
Garudayaksa FC enters the match following a series of three consecutive victories, prompting caution from the Persija technical staff.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Stresses Anti-Corruption Reform Within State Institutions
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto warned officials that corruption within the military, police, and bureaucracy threatens national stability.
The government is evaluating a proposal for 70 percent of mining revenue to be allocated to the state, contingent on commodity considerations.

clusters.headline: Government Opens 154,052 CPNS 2026 Positions and Sets SKD Thresholds
aiSummaryBullets: The 2026 CPNS civil servant recruitment process has officially opened with 154,052 available positions.
Candidates can register and view vacancy details through the official SSCASN portal until December 21, 2026.

clusters.headline: Kemendagri Honors High Performing Regional Governments In Kalimantan
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian Ministry of Home Affairs hosted the 2026 High-Performing Regional Government Awards for the Kalimantan region.
The evaluation process focused on assessing regional administrative performance, coordination, and local economic growth.

clusters.headline: Jakmania Celebrate Persija 98th Anniversary At Bundaran HI Jakarta
aiSummaryBullets: The Jakmania supporters gathered at Bundaran HI on November 27 to celebrate the 98th anniversary of the Persija Jakarta football club.
The large crowd caused heavy traffic congestion in the area, leading authorities to implement traffic management adjustments.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Observes Sekolah Rakyat Student Event
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto observed a performance by Sekolah Rakyat students during the 2026 Bank Indonesia annual meeting.
Minister of Communication and Digitalization Meutya Hafid confirmed successful digital infrastructure integration at various Sekolah Rakyat locations.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Subianto Affirms Indonesia Economic Stability At 5.47 Percent
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto stated that Indonesia's 5.47 percent economic growth reflects solid national fundamentals.
The remarks were delivered during the 2026 Bank Indonesia Annual Meeting held at the central bank's headquarters.

clusters.headline: Letjen Widi Prasetijono Divonis Lima Tahun Penjara Dan Dipecat
aiSummaryBullets: Pengadilan menjatuhkan vonis lima tahun penjara kepada Letjen Widi Prasetijono terkait kasus korupsi lahan Kebun Caruy di Cilacap.
Terpidana diwajibkan membayar denda sebesar Rp200 juta dan dijatuhi sanksi pemecatan dari kedinasan militer.

clusters.headline: BMKG Projects Rain Throughout Indonesia Amid Ongoing Weather Risks
aiSummaryBullets: The BMKG forecasts light rain across the majority of Indonesian regions on Wednesday.
The Jabodetabek area is expected to experience light rainfall according to current meteorological projections.

clusters.headline: Attorney General Investigates Arif Kurniawan Amid Treason Allegations
aiSummaryBullets: The Attorney General's office confirmed it remains focused on investigating Arif Kurniawan for alleged money laundering linked to nickel mining.
Head of Bakom Syahganda Nainggolan publicly identified the businessman as an alleged mastermind behind purported treason efforts against the government.

clusters.headline: Landslides Strike Across West And Central Java Affecting Regions
aiSummaryBullets: Emergency response teams in Banjarnegara successfully evacuated four survivors from a recent landslide site.
Multiple districts in Tasikmalaya and Purwakarta report significant damage to housing and infrastructure following landslides.

clusters.headline: Search Operation For Victims Of PT Fonusa Agung Mulia Fire Extended
aiSummaryBullets: Search and rescue efforts at the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia factory site have been extended for an additional three days.
Operations have been complicated by unstable building structures and dangerous debris, requiring the deployment of K9 units.

clusters.headline: Harga Emas Antam Bertahan di Level Rp2,501 Juta per Gram Hari Ini
aiSummaryBullets: Harga emas batangan produksi PT Aneka Tambang Tbk tidak mengalami perubahan dan tetap berada di level Rp2.501.000 per gram pada Jumat.
Nilai buyback atau harga pembelian kembali emas oleh perusahaan tercatat mengalami kenaikan sebesar Rp3.000 per gram dibandingkan sebelumnya.

clusters.headline: Michael Sianipar Questioned By PSSI Ethics Committee Over FFI Case
aiSummaryBullets: Michael Sianipar was examined for two hours by the PSSI Ethics Committee regarding his dismissal as chairman of the Federasi Futsal Indonesia.
Sianipar filed a formal complaint naming Erick Thohir and Yunus Nusi, citing alleged procedural irregularities and external intervention.

clusters.headline: Listyo Sigit Prabowo Reschedules Ethics Hearing Amid Wiretap Claims
aiSummaryBullets: The Police Code of Ethics Commission postponed the disciplinary hearing for Listyo Sigit Prabowo until next Monday.
The delay followed the officer's refusal to attend the session, which prompted criticism from legislative members regarding institutional accountability.

clusters.headline: SKK Migas And MedcoEnergi Advance National Energy Resilience Goals
aiSummaryBullets: SKK Migas and MedcoEnergi have aligned their operational efforts to strengthen Indonesia's national energy security and independence.
The collaboration forms part of a broader national push to optimize the country's natural resource extraction and sustainable energy management.
